w: A parents’ meet was organised for this evening assembly. After a program of mono-acting, story telling, folk-dance and speeches Swamishri emphasized in his talk about the necessity of inspiring character and values in children. Swamishri said, "Today there is a great need to inculcate good qualities in children. Even in education the authorities are planning very seriously on this matter... It is important for parents to understand their children and their problems. During his/her schooling years one should know and understand their needs. One does not have interest in one’s children’s talks as one has in reading the daily paper.

"Talk politely with him and he will realise his own faults and mistakes. But to insult him or beat him is not proper. The child will not develop from within. To do this the parent has to become like a child and listen to his/her problems and talks. Spend some time and talk to them every evening. And together with this instil good character in their life by doing arti and puja. With the regular contact of Satsang they will be able to imbibe morality. One should read the holy shastras like the Shrimad Bhagvat, Gita, Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato and think upon what you have read. From this, one will attain inner strength..."
At 10.25 a.m., Swamishri arrived at Kishorepura village and performed the murti pratishtha at the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir.
At 10.25 a.m., Swamishri arrived in Matar and performed the murti-pratishtha ceremony and arti of Thakorji in the newly built hari mandir.
At 12.30 p.m., Swamishri arrived in Kalol. In the evening assembly Swamishri was honored with a citation and Key to the City by officials of the local municipality.

At 11.55 pm an earthquake of 5.5 on the Richter scale jolted the city of Amdavad. Swamishri was fast sleep at the time, but for safety from any aftershocks he was awakened. Till 1.00 am Swamishri sat in the mandir compound with sadhus and devotees. After chanting dhun and prayers Swamishri retired to bed.

In Anand, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of murtis for five BAPS hari mandirs for the villages of Thamna, Balasinor, Piplata, Khijalpur and Yoginagar. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the devotees.

Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of murtis for two BAPS hari mandirs of Dhuliya and Varkheda (Khandesh). From 10.50 am Swamishri gave bhagvati diksha to 43 parshads and parshad diksha to 21 youths. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly.
